title: Isosilybin A exhibits anti-inflammatory properties in rosacea by inhibiting MAPK pathway and M1 macrophage polarization.
authors: Wu, Chen-Chen; Ge, Jing-Yao; Huang, Xin-Yue; Liu, Xiao-Ming; Liao, Yan; Zhang, Shui-Jing; Wu, Lin; Chen, Xiao-Fan; Yu, Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Isosilybin A通过MAPK通路和M1巨噬细胞极化治疗玫瑰痤疮的抗炎机制，仅涉及分子对接作为辅助验证，核心对象为小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合体系无关。
abstract: Rosacea is a chronic inflammatory skin disease, which is prone to flares and requires continuous management and treatment. However, long-term use of drugs can lead to additional adverse drug reactions. Based on the comorbid relationship between rosacea and Parkinson's disease, bioinformatics and network pharmacology analysis were used to identify a safer drug for rosacea. It has been demonstrated that ISA has an ameliorative impact on the symptoms of Parkinson's disease. The results demonstrated that ISA exhibited anti-inflammatory properties, including reducing erythema areas and inflammatory cell infiltration in rosacea-like mice models, and inhibiting the expression of inflammatory factors in cellular inflammation models. Furthermore, the anti-inflammatory effect of ISA was associated with inhibition of the Erk, p38 and NF-kappaB signaling pathways and inhibition of macrophage polarization to M1 type. In addition, molecular docking and drug affinity responsive target stability experiment results indicated that VEGFA and RELA were the direct targets of ISA in the treatment for rosacea. In conclusion, these results suggested that ISA may be a potential therapeutic agent for rosacea.
abstract_zh: 玫瑰痤疮是一种慢性炎症性皮肤病，易反复发作，需要持续管理和治疗。然而，长期使用药物可能导致额外的药物不良反应。基于玫瑰痤疮与帕金森病之间的共病关系，采用生物信息学和网络药理学分析来筛选一种更安全的玫瑰痤疮治疗药物。已有研究表明，ISA对帕金森病症状具有改善作用。结果显示，ISA表现出抗炎特性，包括减少玫瑰痤疮样小鼠模型中的红斑面积和炎症细胞浸润，并抑制细胞炎症模型中炎症因子的表达。此外，ISA的抗炎作用与抑制Erk、p38和NF-kappaB信号通路以及抑制巨噬细胞向M1型极化相关。另外，分子对接和药物亲和力响应靶标稳定性实验结果表明，VEGFA和RELA是ISA治疗玫瑰痤疮的直接靶点。总之，这些结果表明ISA可能是玫瑰痤疮的潜在治疗药物。
